items.source: Note: This class is not strictly JSR-236 based; it can work with any regular Executor that can be found in JNDI. The actual adapting to ManagedExecutorService happens in the base class ConcurrentTaskExecutor itself.
items.translation: 注意：该类并非严格基于 JSR-236；它可以与 JNDI 中找到的任何常规 Executor 配合使用。 对 ManagedExecutorService 的实际适配发生在基类 ConcurrentTaskExecutor 本身中。

items.source: Set the JNDI environment to use for JNDI lookups.
items.translation: 设置用于 JNDI 查找的 JNDI 环境。

items.source: Set the JNDI template to use for JNDI lookups.
items.translation: 设置用于 JNDI 查找的 JNDI 模板。

items.source:
This can either be a fully qualified JNDI name, or the JNDI name relative
to the current environment naming context if "resourceRef" is set to "true".
items.translation: 这可以是完全限定的 JNDI 名称，或者如果将"resourceRef"设置为"true"，则是相对于当前环境命名上下文的相对 JNDI 名称。

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。

items.source: Specify a JNDI name of the Executor to delegate to, replacing the default JNDI name "java:comp/DefaultManagedExecutorService".
items.translation: 指定要委托的 `Executor` 的 JNDI 名称，以替换默认 JNDI 名称 "java:comp/DefaultManagedExecutorService"。

items.translation: 设置是否在 Jakarta EE 容器中执行查找，即

items.source:
Set whether the lookup occurs in a Jakarta EE container, i.e. if the prefix
"java:comp/env/" needs to be added if the JNDI name doesn't already
contain it. PersistenceAnnotationBeanPostProcessor's default is "true".
items.translation: 设置是否在 Jakarta EE 容器中执行查找，即如果 JNDI 名称中尚未包含该前缀，是否需要添加"java:comp/env/"。PersistenceAnnotationBeanPostProcessor 的默认值为"true"。
